request.subject: UNIT:CULT:IMP

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one chunky cute creature map piece, a single living thing with big simple rounded rubbery shapes, big round eyes and a clear silhouette that reads at a glance, thick single-colour black outline; the whole creature is visible, and its lowest part is the lowest thing in the image. It holds no weapon and no tool.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple creatures, crowd, robe, hood, cloak, cloth, armour, weapon, flames, fire, candle, horns, claws, fangs, blood, gore, horror, realistic

layers.text: Subject: Imp, a chunky cute small mischievous imp-thing, a lesser monster much smaller than a soldier, standing upright on two short stubby legs: a round rubbery deep-sea teal body, colour #1f8f95 with shade #145f6b, with a pale cream belly, colour #f3e7c4, one single big round pale yellow eye with a black pupil in the middle of its face, colour #ffe27a, a very wide cheeky grin of small blunt pale cream teeth, two tiny teal bat wings on its back far too small to fly, a long thin teal tail ending in a spade-shaped tip curling up behind it, two small pointed ears and one tiny polished brass ring through one ear, two short stubby arms; no clothes, no horns, no claws, no weapon; the feet are the lowest thing in the image; naughty and silly, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.

The imp is drawn large and fills the image. Its two tiny bat wings are spread out wide to both sides of its body so they show clearly in the outline. Its skin is a bright deep-sea teal, lit #2aa6a6 on its left side and #1f8f95 elsewhere, never dark and never green, and nothing on it glows green.
layers.negative: person, human, clothes, hat, pitchfork, trident, fire, flames, green, lime, purple, violet, pink, red, tongue, two eyes, octopus, tentacles, folded wings
